fact: The Seychelles Bureau of Standards was established in 1987 under the SBS Act 1987 as the national standards body, a new SBS Act 2014 replaced it, and 326 national standards had been established, none named as on information technology or data.
title: World Standards Day – October 14: Standards level the playing field
